name: Arcforge Chess Deluxe
subtitle: Chess with a coach and lessons
shortDescription: Beautiful chess with a strong engine, coach, lessons and puzzles.
longDescription:
Chess Deluxe is chess made carefully: a polished wooden board with glossy hand-drawn pieces, a computer opponent you can trust, and a coach that helps you improve.

### Play
- Ten computer levels from curious beginner to a strong club player, plus an adaptive mode that follows your rating.
- Pass & Play for two people on one device.
- Watch & Learn: two computers play while a commentary explains each move in plain words.
- Clocks with increments, undo, hints and an evaluation bar.
- Full rules: castling, en passant, promotion, stalemate, threefold repetition, the fifty-move rule and insufficient material.

### Learn
- A coach comments on every move you make, explains mistakes and draws the better move on the board.
- 36 lessons from how the pieces move to forks, pins, mating patterns, endgames and eight classic openings.
- Hundreds of puzzles with ratings, themed sets, rated mode and a daily puzzle with a streak.
- Game review with an engine score at every move, a graph of the game and accuracy for both sides.
- More than a hundred opening names recognised as you play.

### Beautiful
- Six boards: maple and walnut, walnut and honey, Carrara and Nero marble, emerald, frosted glass and a classic tournament board.
- Six piece sets: chestnut and caramel, ivory and ebony, boxwood and rosewood, marble, crystal, and gold and silver.
- Smooth portrait and landscape on phones and tablets, text zoom up to 300% on every reading page.

### Yours
- Copy and paste games and positions as PGN and FEN.
- Achievements, statistics and ratings stored on your device.

Free to play with ads. An optional monthly subscription removes ads, or you can watch a short video to play ad-free for a while.
whatsNew: Ad-free options on the About page: watch a short video, or subscribe monthly. Banner and level-break ads only in the free version.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
